title: Chinese 'spy' Alice Huang's firms invested in DeepSeek, promised Nvidia's Blackwell chips
summary_full: Alice Huang, associated with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, has drawn scrutiny over her data centre ventures. Companies linked to her invested in DeepSeek to secure Nvidia's Blackwell chips, which are crucial for AI operations. In Singapore, she is under investigation for allegedly misleading authorities during inquiries into her business Megaspeed. Authorities have barred her from re-entering Singapore amid these investigations.
